facts.fact: Togo First reports that Togo's National Cybersecurity Agency (ANCy), led by Director General Gbota Gwaliba, will hold the first Togo Cyber Arena on 19-20 November 2026, with coordination from CERT.tg, described as Togo's national Computer Emergency Response Team.

TGO.note: No incident handled, no alert, no critical infrastructure designation and no incident account stated; the event and the SOC demonstration are not responses.
Data protection is only named as a topic for discussion; no law or authority stated.
Digital sovereignty is only the subject of a keynote; no strategy, rule or hosting stated.
A keynote will address cybersecurity's role in the national digital strategy; the strategy's standing is not stated.
Biometric identification is only a presentation topic; no system status stated.
About 15 startups will exhibit; no startup law, label or fund stated.
Nothing on hubs, incubators or parks.
